manifest.scoring_rule: score = 3*u if any required conflict else 4+5*u (u = weighted satisfied share of preferences, full facts); status_* = recommend/reject/insufficient_info from the target's visible facts
manifest.demographics_note: age band, gender, nationality, hobby are narrative only and enter no rule
manifest.label_note: scores are compatibility under the published synthetic rules, not real human preference
manifest.statuses_are_independent: generation ok != auto check clean != human review passed
